mapper.select: SELECT fo.file_object_id, CAST(NULL AS UNSIGNED) AS property_unit_id, fo.bucket_name, fo.object_key, fo.original_name, fo.content_type, fo.size_bytes, fo.sha256, fo.status FROM property_unit p JOIN layout_template_floor_plan_variant ltfpv ON ltfpv.layout_template_id = p.layout_template_id AND ltfpv.gross_area = p.gross_area AND ltfpv.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN file_object fo ON fo.file_object_id = ltfpv.file_object_id AND fo.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.property_unit_id = #{propertyUnitId}

SELECT fo.file_object_id, CAST(NULL AS UNSIGNED) AS property_unit_id, fo.bucket_name, fo.object_key, fo.original_name, fo.content_type, fo.size_bytes, fo.sha256, fo.status FROM layout_template_floor_plan_variant ltfpv JOIN file_object fo ON fo.file_object_id = ltfpv.file_object_id AND fo.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE ltfpv.layout_template_id = #{layoutTemplateId} AND ltfpv.gross_area = #{grossArea} AND ltfpv.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO layout_template_floor_plan_variant (layout_template_id, gross_area, file_object_id) VALUES (#{layoutTemplateId}, #{grossArea}, #{fileObjectId})
